history.text: Requested a quotation and earliest dispatch dates for our usual shampoo and body wash order, for shipment from Korea to the UK.

Supplier email: Boram asked us to add its newly launched DewPetalHandSerum to the shampoo order. The sales manager said buyers supporting the launch would be considered first when allocating the next shampoo production run, but did not confirm our requested dispatch date.

Purchasing replied that the launch product would require a separate commercial and UK compliance review before any commitment. Asked Boram to confirm availability and dispatch dates for the existing range independently of the launch purchase.

Supplier review: Aramwon Foods confirmed that its four snack and confectionery lines remain available for UK export. Purchase orders should allow for Korean public holidays when requesting dispatch dates.

Supplier email: In response to our request for HoneyButterRicePuffs, Aramwon Foods asked us to add its newly launched YujaCreamWaferRolls to the same order. The account manager said customers supporting the launch would be considered first when production slots were allocated.

Purchasing note: Asked the supplier to confirm the HoneyButterRicePuffs dispatch date independently of any launch purchase. No commitment has been made on YujaCreamWaferRolls; UK labelling details, case pricing and samples have been requested for assessment.
We emailed the supplier requesting a quotation and shipment dates for our usual RoastedGimSeaweed order.

The supplier replied asking us to add its newly launched YujaChilliSeaweedCrisps to the order. Its email said buyers supporting the launch would receive first consideration when seaweed production slots were allocated.

Purchasing asked the supplier to quote the established range separately from YujaChilliSeaweedCrisps and confirm whether declining the launch would affect order acceptance or shipment dates. We also requested the new product's ingredient specification, allergen declaration and proposed UK label before considering a trial.
The supplier provided a separate quotation for DriedAnchovyBites with no launch product included. We asked it to confirm the quoted shipment date in writing before issuing the purchase order.
Requested a quotation and the earliest available sailing for our usual CitrusLiftKitchenSpray order to the UK.

Supplier email: ‘Please add our newly launched GleamNestSinkFoam to your CitrusLiftKitchenSpray order. When allocating production slots, we give preference to customers supporting the launch.’ No separate dispatch date was confirmed for the kitchen spray.

Purchasing asked the supplier to confirm that orders for its established range could proceed without a launch purchase. We also requested UK labelling information, carton quantities and pricing for GleamNestSinkFoam, without committing to buy it.

The supplier confirmed that PureFoldLaundrySheets remained available to order separately at the quoted price. We requested written confirmation of the production date before issuing the purchase order.
Supplier review: Forae confirmed that UK orders are consolidated at its Busan warehouse. Export documentation and English label proofs should be agreed before the collection booking.
Purchasing note: We requested a quotation for our usual RoastedBarleyBrew and JejuGreenTea lines. Forae returned prices for both and asked us to consider its forthcoming HallabongSparklingTea launch.

Supplier email: In response to our request to order RoastedBarleyBrew, Forae asked us to include ten cases of its newly launched HallabongSparklingTea. The sales manager added that buyers supporting the launch would be considered first when production slots for established lines were allocated.

Internal purchasing note: We asked Forae to confirm the RoastedBarleyBrew order independently of the launch offer. No HallabongSparklingTea quantity has been authorised, and we have requested separate pricing, shelf-life details and samples.
Emailed the supplier requesting prices and shipment dates for a repeat UK order of SeoulStackContainer and HanRiverUtensilRack. Asked for the usual carton quantities and delivery terms.

The supplier's reply promoted its newly launched FreshNestVacuumBox and asked us to add six cartons to the repeat order. It said buyers supporting the launch would be considered first when allocating production slots for established lines.

Purchasing asked the supplier to confirm whether repeat orders could retain their normal production scheduling without a launch-product purchase. No commitment to buy the new line has been made; requested a sample and separate quotation for evaluation.
Supplier review: Lumae manufactures kitchenware and household storage products in Korea. Export quotations are in US dollars, with orders consolidated for shipment to the UK.

Purchasing note: requested prices and production dates for a repeat order of BoriSealRiceKeeper and DaroStackPantryBoxes. Asked the supplier to quote the established specifications without additional lines.

Supplier email: alongside our repeat-order quotation, Lumae proposed adding its newly launched MisoDryUtensilPod. The sales manager wrote that buyers supporting the launch would receive first consideration when BoriSealRiceKeeper production slots were allocated.

Reply sent asking Lumae to confirm a production slot for BoriSealRiceKeeper independently of any launch purchase. We requested a separate quotation and samples for MisoDryUtensilPod, without committing to an order.

Colleague's call note: when asked for a repeat quotation for NamuNestPrepBowls, Lumae again recommended taking MisoDryUtensilPod in the same shipment. No link to production allocation or dispatch priority was mentioned during this call.

Quality note: retain the approved hinge-cycle test and carton drop-test requirements on future SoraFoldDishRack purchase orders, regardless of source. Any proposed change to the folding mechanism requires sample approval before production.
